paragraphs.text: The Cloud Nacatl are the descendants of those who chose to remain on the mountains on the Alara shard of Naya , after the Breaking of the Coil . They are considered weak by the Wild Nacatl .

At one time, the Leonin Nacatl were the most civilized race in Naya and the undisputed rulers of the plane. In its heyday, the Nacatl's Empire of the Clouds had an extensive system of roads, bridges, and aqueducts. But internal strife destroyed the empire. A revolutionary group known as the Claws of Marisi waged a guerrilla war, shattering the rule of law and bringing Nacatl civilization to its knees. The Cloud Nacatl still have a few strongholds left in mountains, such as the city of Qasal. In these cities, they still retain allegiance to the Coil , a complicated system of laws that were once recorded on a massive stone wall.
